**Daily Devotional**

**April 17**

*18 And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word, 19 And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful. (Mark 4:18-19 KJV)*

This verse is where Jesus is explaining His parable of the sower to His disciples. This is where the sower just throws the seed out and lets it fall on different types of ground. This type of ground where the seed falls among the thorns, illustrates what happens when we hear the Word of God, and then the cares and activities of this life occupy us so that the devil is able to come steal the Word from us. God’s Word tells us that He will tell us when we get too distracted from His Word (Philippians 3:15). This parable also shows us that the seed (Word) should be thrown out to all types of ground (people), and then the people have the choice to hear and believe the Gospel or reject it. We are not to choose for them.

The Word also tells us that we are to keep our minds on the Word of God (Philippians 3:13), as the mind cannot stay focused on more then one thing at a time without losing the ability to understand and retain. The way to destroy a man’s vision is to give him two. The devil is a master at distracting us from doing what God wants us to. Stay focused on the Lord, and stay in His Word (John 8:31), so you will be His disciple indeed. Thank you Lord for your Word.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
